$comment: UNSCHEDULED US equity closures only — the days no rule can derive.
The regular calendar (New Year's Day, MLK, Washington's Birthday, Good
Friday, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving,
Christmas, plus the published half-days) is COMPUTED from the exchanges'
published rules in `us-market-calendar.ts` and must never be copied here.
Two lists of the same holidays drift, and the one nobody is testing wins.
What belongs here is the residue: a closure the exchanges declared for a
reason a formula cannot know — a national day of mourning, a storm. Each
entry is a date the NYSE and Nasdaq were shut for the whole day.
Dates are exchange-local YYYY-MM-DD in America/New_York.
Half-day closures do NOT belong here; a half day is still a trading day.
